summary: The four front-offset-to-0 moves hide nothing in kernel terms: offset only translates along y, no row cites those four cases, and a hostile sweep of 11 front-offset variants (param, negative, 1e-12, panel value, pocket, datum) was refused with the sentence while front 0 built and matched. But the new front-offset guard fires on offsets the student never wrote (internal repeat/move copies), refusing legitimate parts with a misleading sentence, and the unguarded 'before' data for the four moved cases was never regenerated.

replays.feature: plane-front-0 / plane-top-* / plane-side-* / datum / frame-* (17 cases)
replays.stored: results-guarded/planes.json all PASS, dVol vs closed form 0, front-7 and datum-front-3 refused
replays.live: identical, 17 PASS, 2 refused with the stored sentences

replays.feature: round2 group (10 cases: hex/tri/L/cw rounds and chamfers)

replays.stored: guard refuses all nonzero front offsets
replays.live: param, negative, 1e-12, panel value, pocket all refused; offset 0 and plane('front',0) build and match closed form

defects.feature: front-offset guard vs repeat/move copies (row 1, guardFrontOffset)
defects.problem: A sketch on front with offset 0 whose pocket is repeated along y (repeat(p,{count:2,step:[0,-10,0]})) makes the interpreter write an internal copy sketch sk2 with offset -10; guardFrontOffset then refuses the whole build with 'Sketch sk2 sits on the front plane with an offset of -10 ... would land 20 mm away', although the student wrote no offset and the copy is placed correctly (OCCT built 63434.5). Same with a front offset-20 pocket repeated in x. Honest refusal, but wrong cause in the sentence, over-refusal class not measured by any row.

The four cases were edited to front offset 0 in cases-outline/soup, and results-guarded was rerun, but results/ (the unguarded 'before') still holds the old runs with offsets 4, 3, 2, 3. Before and after therefore compare different inputs; harmless numerically (same volumes) but the pairing is not like for like. geom-front-plane is also ALL-REFUSED by the pre-existing no-coincident-rule guard, so it no longer tests a front soup at all.

cmp-guard.mjs regress crashes (TypeError: {} is not iterable) on a non-array results file, so the documented over-refusal listing cannot be produced; it is the one tool that would have surfaced the repeat/move over-refusal.

notMeasured: Only 14 of 84 rows had their evidence opened by me; the other rows were checked by rebuilding sketch-geometry.json with build-rows.mjs (byte-identical to the stored file, tracked file untouched) and the guard unit checks (33 of 33 pass), not by reading each cited file.
Heavy grid, far, micro and soup groups were not replayed.
Whether blend() or groove on front-plane sketches is over-refused: my two test scripts were refused by the interpreter itself (syntax), so unmeasured.
Curved-build tolerance (up to 1.8e-4 relative vs closed form) was accepted as written, not re-derived.
